summary: TimetableRotation manages the scheduling of rotations within a timetable system, including CRUD operations, date validation, and formatting. It supports searching, adding, updating, deleting, and retrieving rotation details related to cohorts, terms, and courses. The implementation ensures dates fall within permitted ranges and provides formatted outputs for UI display.
purpose: To enable creation, retrieval, update, and deletion of timetable rotation records, associating rotations with cohorts, terms, and courses. It validates rotation dates against timetable and course constraints, formats date outputs, and exposes various search and summary workflows for downstream applications.

workflows.name: Add TimetableRotation
steps: Validate StartDate and EndDate (must not be null, StartDate <= EndDate, both within TimetableStartDate/TimetableEndDate)
If valid, set DB procedure to 'TimetableRotationAdd'
Add TimetableID, StartDate, EndDate as DB parameters

workflows.name: Update TimetableRotation
steps: Validate StartDate and EndDate as above
If valid, set DB procedure to 'TimetableRotationUpdate'
Add ID, StartDate, EndDate as DB parameters

workflows.name: Search TimetableRotation
steps: Add relevant search parameters (TimetableID, CohortID, TermID, CourseID, etc.)
Iterate SqlDataReader results to build TimetableRotation list

workflows.name: Header Retrieval
steps: Iterate results to build list with cohort, term, course header info

workflows.name: Group Worksheet Rotation Count
steps: Add groupFlag, CohortID, TermID, CourseID as parameters
Read rotation count and related details

business_rules: StartDate and EndDate must not be null
StartDate must be less than or equal to EndDate
Both StartDate and EndDate must be within TimetableStartDate and TimetableEndDate
Rotation dates cannot be before course start date or after course end date

validations.rule: Must be within TimetableStartDate and TimetableEndDate

conditions: Only add/update if IsValid returns true
Only delete if ID is not zero
system_behavior: Returns error messages for invalid dates
Supports search and retrieval workflows for reporting
exceptions: StartDate or EndDate is null (error: Start_Date_Required/End_Date_Required)
